header.superHtml:
Get the best of both worlds—the performance of a traditional toothpaste with the purity of a natural toothpaste formula. SuperMouth's innovative nano hydroxyapatite formula is the ideal adults and kids toothpaste, expertly crafted as an adult and kids non fluoride toothpaste for complete family oral care. This dentist-formulated formula delivers advanced protection for healthy smiles at every age.


Recognized among the best hydroxyapatite toothpastes by dental professionals, this advanced formula features our patented Liquid Enamel Technology™, powered by the proprietary Hydroxamin Complex—a unique blend containing at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3, and K2.


This synergistic formula is designed to:

  • Support natural enamel remineralization
  • Reduce tooth sensitivity
  • Help maintain strong, resilient enamel

  • Encourage a healthier oral environment over time


What Is Hydroxyapatite & Liquid Enamel Technology™?

Hydroxyapatite is a naturally occurring calcium phosphate mineral that makes up approximately 97% of tooth enamel. SuperMouth’s Liquid Enamel Technology™ enhances this mineral by combining fluoride and at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite—naturally compatible with your tooth structure—with vitamins D3 and K2. Nano-hydroxyapatite helps fill microscopic imperfections in enamel, creating smoother, stronger teeth.


Fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite work together to support enamel strength, protection, and resilience, helping reduce sensitivity and maintain long-term oral health. This makes SuperMouth an excellent choice for families seeking a trusted family toothpaste that supports healthy smiles from childhood through adulthood.


Key Benefits:

  • Expert Formulation: Developed by leading dentists and oral care specialists for superior oral health.
  • Liquid Enamel Technology™ (Hydroxamin Complex): Proprietary blend with at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite plus vitamins D3 & K2 to strengthen enamel and reduce sensitivity.
  • Xylitol-Enriched: Helps maintain oral moisture and balance.
  • Microbiome-Friendly: Free from harsh essential oils like peppermint, tea tree, and eucalyptus to help preserve the oral microbiome.
  • Naturally Whitens: Gently removes surface stains without damaging enamel.
  • Low Abrasivity: RDA of 67 provides effective cleaning while helping protect enamel.
  • Safety Guarantee: Every ingredient is rated #1 (lowest risk) by the Environmental Working Group (EWG).
  • pH-Balanced Formula: Helps maintain a healthy oral environment for lasting freshness.
  • 100% Clean Ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, antibiotics, and GMOs.
  • Prebiotic Support: Contains inulin and other prebiotics to help support a healthy oral microbiome.
  • Made in the USA: Crafted with premium globally sourced ingredients.
  • Inclusive & Responsible: Gluten-free and paraben-free for families seeking clean oral care solutions.


Transform your family's oral care routine with SuperMouth's fluoride-free toothpaste—the ideal adults and kids toothpaste for stronger enamel, healthier smiles, and everyday protection.

SuperMouth toothpastes feature flavors like Super Mint, crafted to be delicious and refreshing without the burning sensation typically associated with other mint brands. We use light foaming agents to avoid harsh irritants and skip titanium dioxide, a chemical often used to make toothpaste appear white but with potential risks. The result? A safe, effective, and healthy clean every time.

items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Some individuals may opt for non-fluoride toothpaste due to concerns about overexposure to fluoride, allergies, or personal preferences. Choosing a toothpaste without fluoride, like hydroxyapatite non-Fluoride Toothpaste, can be an alternative for those seeking natural oral care solutions. However, it's important to consult your dentist to ensure this choice aligns with your dental health needs.
What is non-fluoride toothpaste?
Non-fluoride toothpaste is a toothpaste formula that does not contain fluoride. Many adults and parents choose non-fluoride options due to personal preferences, concerns about fluoride exposure, or the desire for a more natural oral care routine. SuperMouth's hydroxyapatite non-fluoride toothpaste is formulated for both adults and children, using nano-hydroxyapatite to support enamel strength, remineralization, and overall oral health.
What is hydroxyapatite toothpaste
Hydroxyapatite is a naturally occurring calcium phosphate mineral that closely resembles the structure of tooth enamel. In toothpaste, nano-hydroxyapatite helps support the remineralization process, strengthen enamel, reduce sensitivity, and protect teeth. SuperMouth uses nano-hydroxyapatite in its adult and kids toothpaste formulas to provide gentle, effective oral care for the entire family.
Is hydroxyapatite toothpaste safe for both adults and children?
Yes, SuperMouth's hydroxyapatite toothpaste is designed for both adults and kids. Its gentle, dentist-formulated blend uses nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 and K2, and clean ingredients to support healthy teeth and gums. SuperMouth provides a family-friendly oral care solution.
Is hydroxyapatite better than fluoride?
Both hydroxyapatite and fluoride offer benefits for oral health. Fluoride toothpaste is widely used for helping prevent cavities, while hydroxyapatite toothpaste works by mimicking the natural mineral structure of teeth to support enamel remineralization and protection. SuperMouth offers hydroxyapatite non-fluoride toothpaste as an option for adults and children who prefer fluoride-free oral care.
What is Hydroxamin in SuperMouth products?
Hydroxamin is SuperMouth’s patented formula that combines nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2 to support strong, healthy enamel. Nano-hydroxyapatite helps reinforce the natural mineral structure of teeth, while vitamins D3 and K2 support calcium utilization and overall dental health. This advanced formula makes SuperMouth an ideal adults and kids toothpaste for families seeking clean, effective, and dentist-formulated oral care.
